subject: Executing Python Script in R Shiny

messages.author: df6d28a94eef8d36
messages.subject: Executing Python Script in R Shiny
parts:
Hi Guys,

I was wondering, does Shiny support executing Python scripts? I know I can use rPython to write out Python syntax in Shiny but can I download python packages like pandas, urllib or operator on the Shiny server?

Thanks,
Abdur

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Executing Python Script in R Shiny
parts:
Yes. Just make sure the user that actually runs the Shiny app (by default it's "shiny") has access to those libraries.

You might also consider our new "reticulate" package for using Python from R.
